column1: # Section<TAB>bind<TAB>action -- one line per hl.bind() in hyprland.lua.
# scripts/gen-shortcuts.sh fails if a bind has no line here, or if a line here
# names a bind the config no longer has, so this file cannot drift either.

column3: Open the terminal (kitty)
Open the terminal (kitty) — same as Super + Q
Open the launcher (wofi): type to search apps, Enter to run
Open Dolphin, the file manager
Screenshot a region you select with the mouse, copied to the clipboard
Screenshot the whole screen, copied to the clipboard
Close the focused window
Toggle fullscreen for the focused window
Toggle floating (a normal, movable window) for the focused window
Toggle pseudo-tiling (keep the split but tile as one window)
Swap the split direction of the focused window
Move focus to the window on the left
Move focus to the window on the right
Move focus to the window above
Move focus to the window below
Move the focused window to the left
Move the focused window to the right
Move the focused window up
Move the focused window down
Hold and drag with the left button to move a window
Hold and drag with the right button to resize a window
Switch to workspace 1 … 10 (Super + 1 is the first, Super + 0 the tenth)
Move the focused window to workspace 1 … 10
Switch to the previous workspace (scroll down on the desktop)
Switch to the next workspace (scroll up on the desktop)
Volume up in 5 % steps (up to 140 %)
Volume down in 5 % steps
Mute or unmute the sound output
Play or pause the current track (playerctl)
Next track
Previous track
Screen brighter (brightnessctl, needs a backlight)
Screen dimmer (brightnessctl, needs a backlight)
Lock the screen (loginctl lock-session)
Reload the Hyprland configuration after editing it
Exit Hyprland (log out; SDDM comes back)
